svg.title: resolution
svg.desc: At 550 nm, instrumental FWHM = λ/R. Intrinsic Gaussian sigma is 0.0005 nm, convolved analytically with the Gaussian instrument profile. R, sampling and noise are separate. ESO overview gives nominal HARPS R=115,000; manual 3.3.12 lists measured R=120,000 and 4.1 pixels/FWHM. The two presets retain this distinction. Real HARPS line-spread functions are not universally Gaussian. Distinguishability depends on line shape, contrast, sampling, SNR and inference method; there is no universal hard threshold. Sources: https://www.eso.org/sci/facilities/lasilla/instruments/harps/overview.html https://ftp.eso.org/pub/dfs/pipelines/instruments/harps/harps-pipeline-manual-3.3.12.pdf https://arxiv.org/abs/2011.03391
